'''Barcola''' was a barren [[Moon/Legends|moon]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] team under the command of [[Charls Ginsbrack]] used it as a base for their development of new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology, presumably to help with the Alliance's war effort. They abandoned the moon after they were forced to shut down the project, because the new hyperdrives created hyperdimensional whirlpools that killed a number of members of the scientific team.
